name: smit-ams
description: SMIT Academic Management System — React client and Express API

scripts.setup: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.start: npm run setup && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n client,api -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.preview: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix client run preview
